title: Taskeene Qalbe Zehra Abbas Abbas
body:
Taskeen e Qalbe Zehra(s.a) Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s)
<<MINI>>
Zainab(s.a) ka tha ye nouha Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ummul Banee'n(s.a) ke pyaare, Haider(a.s) ke jigar paare
Aye Noore ain e Zehre(s.a) Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s)
2. Katwake Apne Baazu Tum sogaye Naher par
Kya hoega Haram ka Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Sharminda bhatiji se you'n hogaye ke laasha
Khaime me tak na aayaAbbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s)
4. Tha choor tan e sarwar(a.s) har zaqm dil se har dam
Aati thi ye sada Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Aada ne cheenli jab Zainab(s.a) ke sar se chaadar
<<MINI>>
Zainab(s.a) ka tha ye nouha Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Kyu'n Sarfaraaz mushkil Apne ko hogi haayil
Apna to hai sahaara Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s)
Kalaam : Janaab Syed Sarfaraz Ali Razvi Sahab Qibla
